"""
This module provide the function :py:func:`summary` that is used for printing
an `execution summary
<https://github.com/spotify/luigi/blob/master/examples/execution_summary_example.py>`_
at the end of luigi invocations.
"""

import textwrap
import collections
import functools

import luigi


class execution_summary(luigi.Config):
    summary_length = luigi.IntParameter(default=5)


def _partition_tasks(worker):
    """
    Takes a worker and sorts out tasks based on their status.
    Still_pending_not_ext is only used to get upstream_failure, upstream_missing_dependency and run_by_other_worker
    """
    history = worker._add_task_history
    pending = set()
    for entry in history:
        if entry[1] == 'PENDING':
            pending.add(entry[0])
    buckets = {}
    buckets["completed"] = {t for (t, s, e) in history if s == 'DONE' and t in pending}
    buckets["already_done"] = {t for (t, s, e) in history
                               if s == 'DONE' and t not in pending and t not in buckets["completed"]}
    buckets["failed"] = {t for (t, s, e) in history if s == 'FAILED'}
    buckets["scheduling_error"] = {t for (t, s, e) in history if s == 'UNKNOWN'}
    buckets["still_pending_ext"] = {t for (t, s, e) in history
                                    if s == 'PENDING' and t not in buckets["failed"] and t not in buckets["completed"] and not e}
    buckets["still_pending_not_ext"] = {t for (t, s, e) in history
                                        if s == 'PENDING' and t not in buckets["failed"] and t not in buckets["completed"] and e}
    buckets["run_by_other_worker"] = set()
    buckets["upstream_failure"] = set()
    buckets["upstream_missing_dependency"] = set()
    buckets["upstream_run_by_other_worker"] = set()
    buckets["upstream_scheduling_error"] = set()
    buckets["not_run"] = set()
    return buckets


def _root_task(worker):
    """
    Return the first task scheduled by the worker, corresponding to the root task
    """
    return worker._add_task_history[0][0]


def _populate_unknown_statuses(buckets):
    """
    Add the "upstream_*" and "not_run" statuses my mutating set_tasks.
    """
    seen = set()
    for node in buckets["still_pending_not_ext"]:
        _depth_first_search(buckets, node, seen)


def _depth_first_search(buckets, node, seen):
    """
    This dfs checks why tasks are still pending.
    """
    seen.add(node)
    if node in buckets["still_pending_not_ext"]:
        has_upstream_failure = False
        has_upstream_missing_dependency = False
        has_upstream_run_by_other_worker = False
        has_upstream_scheduling_error = False
        for dep in node._requires():
            if dep not in seen:
                _depth_first_search(buckets, dep, seen)
            if dep in buckets["failed"] or dep in buckets["upstream_failure"]:
                buckets["upstream_failure"].add(node)
                has_upstream_failure = True
            if dep in buckets["still_pending_ext"] or dep in buckets["upstream_missing_dependency"]:
                buckets["upstream_missing_dependency"].add(node)
                has_upstream_missing_dependency = True
            if dep in buckets["run_by_other_worker"] or dep in buckets["upstream_run_by_other_worker"]:
                buckets["upstream_run_by_other_worker"].add(node)
                has_upstream_run_by_other_worker = True
            if dep in buckets["scheduling_error"]:
                buckets["upstream_scheduling_error"].add(node)
                has_upstream_scheduling_error = True
        if (not has_upstream_failure) and (not has_upstream_missing_dependency) and \
                (not has_upstream_run_by_other_worker) and (not has_upstream_scheduling_error) and \
                (node not in buckets["run_by_other_worker"]):
            buckets["not_run"].add(node)


def _get_str(task_dict, extra_indent):
    """
    This returns a string for each status
    """
    limit = execution_summary().summary_length

    out_lines = []
    families = sorted(task_dict.keys())
    for family in families:
        task_list = task_dict[family]
        task_list = sorted(task_list, key=lambda t: str(t))
        prefix = ' ' * (8 if extra_indent else 4)

        line = None

        if limit > 0 and len(out_lines) >= limit:
            out_lines.append(prefix + "...")
            break
        if len(task_list[0].get_params()) == 0:
            line = prefix + '- {0} {1}()'.format(len(task_list), str(family))
        elif (_get_len_of_params(task_list[0]) > 60 or len(str(task_list[0])) > 200 or
              (len(task_list) == 2 and len(task_list[0].get_params()) > 1 and (_get_len_of_params(task_list[0]) > 40 or len(str(task_list[0])) > 100))):
            """
            This is to make sure that there is no really long task in the output
            """
            line = prefix + '- {0} {1}(...)'.format(len(task_list), family)
        elif len((task_list[0].get_params())) == 1:
            attrs = {getattr(t, task_list[0].get_params()[0][0]) for t in task_list}
            p_class = task_list[0].get_params()[0][1]
            first, last = _ranging_attributes(attrs, p_class)
            if first is not None and last is not None and len(attrs) > 3:
                p_str = '{0}...{1}'.format(p_class.serialize(first), p_class.serialize(last))
            else:
                p_str = '{0}'.format(_get_str_one_parameter(task_list))
            line = prefix + '- {0} {1}({2}={3})'.format(len(task_list), family, task_list[0].get_params()[0][0], p_str)
        else:
            ranging = False
            params = _get_set_of_params(task_list)
            unique_keys = list(_get_unique_param_keys(params))
            if len(unique_keys) == 1:
                unique_param, = unique_keys
                attrs = params[unique_param]
                p_class = unique_param[1]
                first, last = _ranging_attributes(attrs, p_class)
                if first is not None and last is not None and len(attrs) > 2:
                    ranging = True
                    line = prefix + '- {0} {1}({2}'.format(len(task_list), family, _get_str_ranging_multiple_parameters(first, last, task_list, unique_param))
            if not ranging:
                if len(task_list) == 1:
                    line = prefix + '- {0} {1}'.format(len(task_list), task_list[0])
                if len(task_list) == 2:
                    line = prefix + '- {0} {1} and {2}'.format(len(task_list), task_list[0], task_list[1])
                if len(task_list) > 2:
                    line = prefix + '- {0} {1} ...'.format(len(task_list), task_list[0])
        out_lines.append(line)
    return '\n'.join(out_lines)


def _get_len_of_params(task):
    total = 0
    for p in task.get_params():
        total += len(p[0])
    return total


def _get_str_ranging_multiple_parameters(first, last, task_list, unique_param):
    row = ''
    str_unique_param = '{0}...{1}'.format(unique_param[1].serialize(first), unique_param[1].serialize(last))
    param_list = task_list[0].get_params()
    for param in param_list:
        row += '{0}='.format(param[0])
        if param[0] == unique_param[0]:
            row += '{0}'.format(str_unique_param)
        else:
            row += '{0}'.format(param[1].serialize(getattr(task_list[0], param[0])))
        if param != param_list[-1]:
            row += ", "
    row += ')'
    return row


def _get_set_of_params(task_list):
    params = {}
    for param in task_list[0].get_params():
        params[param] = {getattr(t, param[0]) for t in task_list}
    return params


def _get_unique_param_keys(params):
    for key, values in params.items():
        if len(values) > 1:
            yield key


def _ranging_attributes(attrs, p_class):
    """
    Checks if there is a continuous range
    """
    next_attrs = {p_class.next_in_enumeration(a) for a in attrs}
    in_first = attrs.difference(next_attrs)
    in_second = next_attrs.difference(attrs)
    if len(in_first) == 1 and len(in_second) == 1:
        for x in attrs:
            if {p_class.next_in_enumeration(x)} == in_second:
                return next(iter(in_first)), x
    return None, None


def _get_str_one_parameter(task_list):
    row = ''
    count = 0
    for t in task_list:
        if (len(row) >= 30 and count > 2 and count != len(task_list) - 1) or len(row) > 200:
            row += '...'
            break
        param = t.get_params()[0]
        row += '{0}'.format(param[1].serialize(getattr(t, param[0])))
        if count < len(task_list) - 1:
            row += ','
        count += 1
    return row


def _serialize_first_param(task):
    first_param = task.get_params()[0]
    return first_param[1].serialize(getattr(task, first_param[0]))


def _get_number_of_tasks_for(status, grouped):
    if status == "still_pending":
        return (_get_number_of_tasks(grouped["still_pending_ext"]) +
                _get_number_of_tasks(grouped["still_pending_not_ext"]))
    return _get_number_of_tasks(grouped[status])


def _get_number_of_tasks(task_dict):
    total = 0
    for bucket in task_dict.values():
        total += len(bucket)
    return total


def _get_comments(grouped):
    """
    Get the human readable comments and quantities for the task types.
    """
    comments = {}
    for status, human in _COMMENTS:
        n = _get_number_of_tasks_for(status, grouped)
        if n:
            space = "    " if status in _PENDING_SUB_STATUSES else ""
            comments[status] = '{space}* {num_tasks} {human}:\n'.format(
                space=space,
                num_tasks=n,
                human=human)
    return comments


# Oredered in the sense that they'll be printed in this order
_ORDERED_STATUSES = (
    "already_done",
    "completed",
    "failed",
    "scheduling_error",
    "still_pending",
    "still_pending_ext",
    "run_by_other_worker",
    "upstream_failure",
    "upstream_missing_dependency",
    "upstream_run_by_other_worker",
    "upstream_scheduling_error",
    "not_run",
)
_PENDING_SUB_STATUSES = set(_ORDERED_STATUSES[_ORDERED_STATUSES.index("still_pending_ext"):])
_COMMENTS = set((
    ("already_done", 'present dependencies were encountered'),
    ("completed", 'ran successfully'),
    ("failed", 'failed'),
    ("scheduling_error", 'failed scheduling'),
    ("still_pending", 'were left pending, among these'),
    ("still_pending_ext", 'were missing external dependencies'),
    ("run_by_other_worker", 'were being run by another worker'),
    ("upstream_failure", 'had failed dependencies'),
    ("upstream_missing_dependency", 'had missing external dependencies'),
    ("upstream_run_by_other_worker", 'had dependencies that were being run by other worker'),
    ("upstream_scheduling_error", 'had dependencies whose scheduling failed'),
    ("not_run", 'was not granted run permission by the scheduler'),
))


def _get_run_by_other_worker(worker):
    """
    This returns a set of the tasks that are being run by other worker
    """
    worker_task_sets = _get_external_workers(worker).values()
    return functools.reduce(lambda acc, s: acc | s, worker_task_sets, set())


def _get_external_workers(worker):
    """
    This returns a dict with a set of tasks for all of the other workers
    """
    blocked_by = collections.defaultdict(set)
    responses = worker._get_work_response_history
    for response in responses:
        if response['task_id'] is None:
            for running_task in response['running_tasks']:
                other_worker_id = running_task['worker']
                other_task_id = running_task['task_id']
                other_task = worker._scheduled_tasks.get(other_task_id)
                if other_worker_id == worker._id or not other_task:
                    continue
                blocked_by[other_worker_id].add(other_task)
    return blocked_by


def _group_tasks_by_name_and_status(task_dict):
    """
    Takes a dictionary with sets of tasks grouped by their status and
    returns a dictionary with dictionaries with an array of tasks grouped by
    their status and task name
    """
    grouped = {}
    for t in task_dict:
        if t.task_family not in grouped:
            grouped[t.task_family] = []
        grouped[t.task_family].append(t)
    return grouped


def _summary_dict(worker):
    buckets = _partition_tasks(worker)
    buckets["run_by_other_worker"] = _get_run_by_other_worker(worker)
    _populate_unknown_statuses(buckets)
    return buckets


def _summary_format(buckets, worker):
    grouped = {}
    for status, task_dict in buckets.items():
        grouped[status] = _group_tasks_by_name_and_status(task_dict)
    comments = _get_comments(grouped)
    num_all_tasks = sum([len(buckets["already_done"]),
                         len(buckets["completed"]), len(buckets["failed"]),
                         len(buckets["scheduling_error"]),
                         len(buckets["still_pending_ext"]),
                         len(buckets["still_pending_not_ext"])])
    str_output = 'Scheduled {0} tasks of which:\n'.format(num_all_tasks)
    for status in _ORDERED_STATUSES:
        if status not in comments:
            continue
        str_output += '{0}'.format(comments[status])
        if status != 'still_pending':
            str_output += '{0}\n'.format(_get_str(grouped[status], status in _PENDING_SUB_STATUSES))
    ext_workers = _get_external_workers(worker)
    grouped_ext_workers = {}
    for ext_worker, task_dict in ext_workers.items():
        grouped_ext_workers[ext_worker] = _group_tasks_by_name_and_status(task_dict)
    if len(ext_workers) > 0:
        str_output += "\nThe other workers were:\n"
        count = 0
        for ext_worker, task_dict in ext_workers.items():
            if count > 3 and count < len(ext_workers) - 1:
                str_output += "    and {0} other workers".format(len(ext_workers) - count)
                break
            str_output += "    - {0} ran {1} tasks\n".format(ext_worker, len(task_dict))
            count += 1
        str_output += '\n'
    if num_all_tasks == sum([len(buckets["already_done"]),
                             len(buckets["scheduling_error"]),
                             len(buckets["still_pending_ext"]),
                             len(buckets["still_pending_not_ext"])]):
        if len(ext_workers) == 0:
            str_output += '\n'
        str_output += 'Did not run any tasks'
    smiley = ""
    reason = ""
    if buckets["failed"]:
        smiley = ":("
        reason = "there were failed tasks"
        if buckets["scheduling_error"]:
            reason += " and tasks whose scheduling failed"
    elif buckets["scheduling_error"]:
        smiley = ":("
        reason = "there were tasks whose scheduling failed"
    elif buckets["not_run"]:
        smiley = ":|"
        reason = "there were tasks that were not granted run permission by the scheduler"
    elif buckets["still_pending_ext"]:
        smiley = ":|"
        reason = "there were missing external dependencies"
    else:
        smiley = ":)"
        reason = "there were no failed tasks or missing external dependencies"
    str_output += "\nThis progress looks {0} because {1}".format(smiley, reason)
    if num_all_tasks == 0:
        str_output = 'Did not schedule any tasks'
    return str_output


def _summary_wrap(text):
    return textwrap.dedent("""
    ===== Luigi Execution Summary =====

    {str_output}

    ===== Luigi Execution Summary =====
    """).format(str_output=text)


def summary(worker):
    """
    Given a worker, return a human readable summary of what the worker have
    done.
    """
    return _summary_wrap(_summary_format(_summary_dict(worker), worker))
